snippet.title: GB Corp Release Trailer
snippet.description:
GB Corp. is a micro-management idle game for the Nintendo Game Boy written by Dr Ludos with a unique feature: it is the first game where the Game Boy you use to play has an impact on the game.

The prototype version of the game is downloadable and also playable in your browser here: https://drludos.itch.io/gb-corp

The complete version of the game that you'll get by backing this project on KickStarter will contain many additional features. 
For example, it supports more console models (GBA, SGB2) and you'll be able to link two different consoles types through a link cable to have two GB types working at the same time on screen!

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/yastunagames/gb-corp-a-new-physical-gameboy-game
